segments.line: I used to bloat up every single afternoon. It was honestly miserable.
segments.visual: creator talking directly to camera, intimate handheld selfie framing, kitchen background

segments.line: Then my sister told me about these seagrass gummies from Velantra.
segments.visual: creator holds the product jar up to frame, slight rotate to show the label

segments.line: Two weeks later? The bloat was just gone.
segments.visual: b-roll: product jar on a sunny windowsill, gummies spilling out, no speaker
